system.description:
Once per Doom Quarter, roll 1 Skill Die to brew a throwable flask: Grit = Molotov (p147), Wit = Oil Flask (p148), Smarts = Acid Flask (p146), Heart = Sunlight Flask (p148), Luck = your choice. Strange = the experiment backfires and you take 2 Blunt damage.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.46
system.summary: Once per Doom Quarter, roll 1 Skill Die to brew a throwable flask: Grit = Molotov (p147), Wit = Oil Flask (p148), Smarts = Acid Flask (p146), Heart = Sunlight Flask (p148), Luck = your choice. Strange = the experiment backfires and you take 2 Blunt damage.

automation.note: Roll 1 Skill Die: Grit Molotov, Wit Oil Flask, Smarts Acid Flask, Heart Sunlight Flask, Luck any of these; add the flask to your gear. Strange: no flask and you take 2 Blunt damage.
